registration.name: Round 2 free-field stable-bearing range versus ambient floor

preregistration.registered_before: Any outcomes from this range/noise population
preregistration.source: Existing sparse_50 glass-breaking clip,105dBSPL at1m; range is horizontal distance from node centroid, not identical range to each mic. Known synthetic propagation; no housing/phase response.
preregistration.metrics: Any accepted mixture bearing track per node and its seed-cluster mean; any fix, conditional horizontal error, useful and unflagged-wrong scene rates. Track presence is a detection proxy, not verified event/classification accuracy; no noise-only false-alarm control is claimed.
preregistration.uncertainty: Two observed seed-cluster values and their range; no reliable population95%CI from two clusters. Preserve no-fix errors as null.
preregistration.hardware_table: Only derive a hardware requirement if a target-compliant regime is demonstrated and the relevant impairment was varied. Otherwise requirement fields remain null with reasons. Ambient floor is not microphone self-noise; no clock/sync requirement can follow from a model without inter-node TDOA.
preregistration.scope: Complete equal population for all9 designs, not all sites or sealed conditions. This is not the full improved-engine ranking and cannot name a hardware winner.

producer.audio_source: repository test-audio recordings, PCM float32 mono at 48000 Hz

targets.scope: Starting design targets, not validated acceptance limits. Error targets apply to scenes with source reference range up to 50 m; mixed-range tables are indicative only.

notes: Two observed seed-cluster values/range, not a reliable population95%CI. Stable track presence is a detection proxy, not verified event/classification accuracy. No hardware winner; all no-fix errors remain null.

hardware_requirements.reason: Ambient floor, not mic self-noise, was swept; heading is bundled with other realism errors; no synchronized inter-node TDOA model. Retained all-suspect fixes cannot establish useful-fix target compliance. Do not invent tolerances from conditional errors.
